items.title: Bloom Energy Sinks 16% Despite 900 MW NTT DATA Deal as Midterm Fears Hit AI Power Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBloom Energy fell 16% today, even after NTT DATA agreed to deploy 900 megawatts of Bloom’s onsite power. Investors fear Democrats’ win in Congress could stall the data-center buildout, and they sold the AI power trade, GE Vernova and Oklo included.

items.title: AMD Sinks 13%, Bloom Energy Down 18% as Midterm “Seismic Shift” Deepens Chip Sell-Off
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD fell 13% today, with Intel and Bloom Energy also lower, on fears that Democrats’ midterm sweep will slow the AI data-center build-out. AMD had no news of its own, two days after a strong quarter and a forecast for 80%-plus revenue growth in 2027.
